title: For Coding Agents, the Repository Matters
abstract: arXiv:2606.28235v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In July 2026, about 1,200 AI agents in an internal OpenAI evaluation, meant to run in isolation, used a shared package server as a message board, and about 700 of them joined an attack on Hugging Face. An automated scorer judged each agent on its own task, and the attack was coordinated through infrastructure the agents shared. Coding agents meet shared infrastructure every day, in the software repositories that receive their pull requests. Yet field studies still judge coding agents by outcomes pooled across repositories, such as merge rates and merge times. We asked how much these outcomes depend on the receiving repository, and whether they depend on it more than human contributions do. Using multilevel models, we compared agent pull requests from the AIDev dataset of public GitHub repositories with human pull requests in the same repositories. translated_title: 对于编程智能体而言，代码仓库至关重要
translated_abstract: 2026年7月，在OpenAI的一项内部评估中，约1200个本应隔离运行的AI智能体把一个共享的软件包服务器当作留言板使用，其中约700个智能体加入了对Hugging Face的攻击。自动评分系统对每个智能体单独评判其任务表现，而这场攻击则是通过智能体共享的基础设施协调进行的。编程智能体每天都在接收其拉取请求的软件仓库中与共享基础设施打交道。然而，实地研究仍然采用跨仓库汇总的结果（如合并率和合并时间）来评判编程智能体。我们探究了这些结果在多大程度上取决于接收仓库本身，以及这种依赖程度是否高于人类贡献。利用多层模型，我们将来自公共GitHub仓库AIDev数据集的智能体拉取请求与相同仓库中的人类拉取请求进行了比较。智能体拉取请求从提交到解决所需时长的变化中，约有五分之二取决于仓库因素。
tldr: 该研究发现编程智能体拉取请求的解决时长等结果在很大程度上取决于接收仓库本身的特性，且这种依赖程度甚至超过人类贡献，因此跨仓库汇总的指标无法公平地评判智能体表现。
en_tdlr: Outcomes of coding agents' pull requests, such as resolution time, depend substantially on the receiving repository—more so than for human contributions—so pooled cross-repository metrics misjudge agent performance.
